Verification page heading

This verification paragraph exists to give the readability extractor enough prose to return a confident article body. It contains multiple sentences with regular punctuation so that the prose ratio measured by the quality gate stays well above the rejection threshold used at ingest time.

A second paragraph provides additional sentence structure. Retrieval quality depends on extraction quality, and extraction quality depends on the density algorithm choosing the article container over the navigation chrome that surrounds it on every modern web page published today.

Secondary section

The second section confirms that headings inside the article container are preserved by the extractor rather than dropped with the page furniture.
